notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Termination Facilitator.
Termination Facilitator does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Termination Facilitator by tapping it, targeting any creature.
Horobi triggers, destroying that creature.
When the creature dies, Termination Facilitator triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
 You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.
